items.coder_A: Platinum partner in Part 3b (SCLC/NEC only) could be read as background standard chemotherapy or as a combination candidate; not given in the GBM-eligible parts.
items.reason: Part 3b gives ABBV-706 'in combination with carboplatin or cisplatin' to second-line SCLC/NEC patients; platinum is the standard backbone there, like temozolomide in 'Stupp + X', and the investigational question is ABBV-706. Not given in the GBM-eligible parts (1 and 4a).

items.coder_A: Platinum partner in Part 3b (SCLC/NEC only) could be read as background standard chemotherapy or as a combination candidate; not given in the GBM-eligible parts.
items.reason: Same reasoning as carboplatin: standard platinum backbone in the SCLC/NEC-only Part 3b.

items.coder_A: Part 1 criterion says tumours with 'potential SEZ6 expression'; unclear whether SEZ6 expression is an entry requirement or only retrospective analysis.
items.proposed: SEZ6 stays exploratory_correlative (not an entry requirement)
items.reason: Tissue is collected 'for retrospective SEZ6 expression analysis'; 'potential SEZ6 expression' describes tumour types, not a test result required for entry. No effect on the primary outcome.

Both coders coded regimen 'monotherapy' for the GBM-eligible parts (Part 1 and Part 4a, ABBV-706 alone), so combination_partners should be empty. Budigalimab and platinum are given only in the SCLC/NEC Parts 3a/3b.

note: Same regimen convention question as NCT06047379 (GBM-eligible arms vs whole trial). Budigalimab is a candidate only in the non-GBM Part 3a; XL may want to decide whether non-GBM-arm candidates count for agent-level analyses.
